name: Hub
author: Brett
description: Every axHub web page as a console screen (hub-console@1, framework/spec/HUB-CONSOLE.md): Approvals, Approval log, Passes and veto, Users, Account, Apps and connectors (with each service's detail), Handoff, Auth admin and Apps, in one Hub view with a tab-group row drawn from the route table framework/schemas/hub-console.json. Reads go through this plugin's server with the console's hub token or its own hub session; every decision (approve, deny, shelve, grant a pass, delete a user, create a token) is Brett's own tap through the approvals-banner relay, registered personOnly so no session, tool or command can run it. Every screen has a deep link (view:hub/tab:hub.tabs=<screen>), a REST read, an MCP tool, a CLI line (axf hub …) and a voice action (hub.<screen>). Settings → Plugins → Hub holds every former axHub web setting. The console is the only hub UI; axHub stays the backend and MCP hub.

keeps: The hub's own data (approvals, passes, users, services) lives on axHub and is never touched by uninstall
/projects/_shared/_data/settings/apps/axf-console.json keeps the axf.hub.* settings the migration wrote (remove them by hand if unwanted)

items.title: Passes: ask Brett for a pass
items.description: Asks for a timed pass (service, scope and/or tools, minutes, reason). It waits on Hub → Passes with a Grant button: the grant stays Brett's click.

items.title: Passes: revoke a pass
items.description: Ends a pass now; the first call answers confirmation_required with a token, the second carries it as confirm.

items.title: Passes: extend a pass
items.description: Extends a pass by {minutes} from now.

items.title: Passes: end the go pass
items.description: Ends the go pass now: sessions that cannot reach axHub wait again.

items.title: Veto: set the countdown
items.description: Sets the veto countdown in seconds on every tool axHub holds for a veto (the registered setting axf.hub.veto.countdownSeconds; the first call answers confirmation_required with a token, the second carries it).

items.title: Users: add an account
items.description: Adds a hub account with a temporary password they replace at first sign-in (username, name, email, password, role). A confirm: the first call answers a token, the second carries it.

items.title: Users: save name and email
items.description: Saves an account's name and email.

items.title: Users: change role
items.description: Changes an account's role (a confirm).

items.title: Users: save permissions
items.description: Saves the permissions apps behind the wall see for an account (a confirm).

items.title: Users: enable
items.description: Enables a disabled account.

items.title: Users: disable
items.description: Disables an account (a confirm).

items.title: Users: sign out everywhere
items.description: Signs an account out of every browser (a confirm).

items.title: Users: delete
items.description: Deletes an account (a confirm; the hub keeps the last admin and Brett's own account safe).

items.description: Adds a connector. axHub has no route for it yet: answers hub_missing with the proposed route and the hub's own CLI line.

items.title: Connectors: reconnect
items.description: Reconnects a service. axHub has no route for it yet: answers hub_missing.

items.title: Connectors: remove
items.description: Removes a connector. axHub has no route for it yet: answers hub_missing.

items.title: Handoff: mark sent
items.description: Marks a handoff run sent to a session.

items.title: Handoff: accept on this device
items.description: Accepts a handoff on this device: waits on the hub protocol (answers hub_missing).

items.title: Handoff: clear
items.description: Clears a handoff run: the hub has no delete route yet (answers hub_missing).

items.title: Auth: revoke a token
items.description: Revokes an API token (a confirm): the hub has no token admin route yet (answers hub_missing).

items.title: Auth: add an OAuth client
items.description: Adds an OAuth client (a confirm): the hub has no route yet (answers hub_missing).

items.title: Auth: remove an OAuth client

items.title: Apps: download
items.description: Answers the hub's own download address of an app's latest build (a navigate).

items.title: Approvals: tell the phone now
items.description: Sends every waiting call the phone has not heard of to Phone Connect, each with the console deep link that opens Hub → Approvals on that request.
